text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Senior Class summer training camp neared its endâ

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—So, her next race will be
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am sure you are all already aware, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No Umamusume who has followed the Tiara path
like me has ever won the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
in all of history.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However.
I, Air Groove, as the 'Empress,'
shall rewrite that history."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooooh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow has already declared his intention to take back-to-back victories in this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn), but what are your thoughts on this...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, that is no reason
for me to stop moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No matter who my opponent is, victory is the only option.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This declaration by Air Groove
spread among racing fans in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is so cool!
Her raw talent is hands down top-notch, so I'm really hoping she can pull off a great feat following Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Still, isn't that a bit too rough...? That Bubble is standing right in her way, and no Tiara Umamusume has ever won before—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: Even back during Bubble's time, people were saying "Classic-tier Umamusume are this and that~," so it's totally possible!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
It really feels like times are changing, doesn't it?
I'm starting to want to root for Air Groove...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And then, the morning of the training camp's final day.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Hey.
Did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No—
Right on time."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "...And so? What did you want to talk about?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Even so,
there's only one real answer between us right now, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow.
In the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will defeat you. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is... a declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (What overwhelming pressure— When did she become like this...?!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...The duty I must fulfill
is to become the 'ideal' for all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And what an "ideal" Umamusume truly is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Those who fearlessly challenge the strong, make the impossible possible,
and forge the future."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Do you understand, Bubble?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the first-ever Classic-class victory last year,
you now run aiming for back-to-back titles in
this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is truly a decisive battle worthy of embodying the "ideal" I strive for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will surpass a powerhouse like you...
and become the very first Tiara Umamusume in history to seize victory."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "And so, let us blaze a new trail. Into an uncharted domain for Air Groove, the 'Empress.'"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Now things are getting wild.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's give it our all in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Will it be the first back-to-back victory in history?
Or the first ever win by a Tiara umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
one of us will carve out a new chapter in history.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just...
fire you right up!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Summer is coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And it comes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Autumn approaches, carrying a history-altering showdown—
